copy.about: Either badge linked to the listing qualifies for review on the official website or in a README. Eligibility is 80–99. Show an end date only when ends_at is set.
copy.offer_short: Add your badge to your website or README. Verified listings scoring 80–99 can earn a featured placement.
copy.offer_long: Add either quality badge to your official website and link it to your Suede listing. A repository or skill README also qualifies. Send us the page URL or README path. Once Suede verifies the badge, skills scoring 80–99 can receive a featured placement while the offer is open.
copy.partners_intro: These publishers display a quality badge linked to their listing on their website or in their README. Suede verified each placement.

outreach_priority.about: Order for inviting publishers to add badges. Messages are drafted for approval and never sent automatically. See directory/STRATEGY.md section 4.
